Chat Edit: 'Problem Found What to Fix Why Fix It? (Risk) 1. Business Mismatch (Critical)
Your Trade License is for Hardware/Cement (M.R. Traders), but the Uttara Bank Statement shows transactions for "Wedding Jewellery," "Gold Rings," and "Silver Chains". Action: Submit a bank statement that reflects Construction/Hardware sales. Remove the jewelry statement unless you attach a Trade License for a Jewelry business. Refusal Risk: High. This looks like fraud (PIC 4020). The officer will suspect you are using someone else's bank statement or a fake one because it does not match your trade. 2. Wrong Travel Dates
The Itinerary lists travel for Feb 15–28, 2026, but you stated you want to travel for the March Eid Vacation. Action: Update the Itinerary dates to March 2026 (e.g., March 15–28) to align with the Eid holidays. Refusal Risk: Medium. Inconsistent information. A "Ramadan/Eid" trip cannot happen in February 2026. 3. "Future" Dating (Fabrication)
Bank statements, Affidavits, and Valuations are dated January 21, 2026, which is in the future. Action: Re-generate all documents with the current (today's) date. Refusal Risk: Certain. Submitting a document dated in the future proves it is a created/fake document, not a genuine record. 4. Typos in "Official" Bank Docs
The Pubali Bank statement footer reads: "TAIKEN TAHT THE HAS FOUND" instead of "Taken that he has found". Action: Go to the bank branch and request a genuine system-generated statement. Do not use this file. Refusal Risk: High. Banks do not have spelling errors in their software. This signals a forged document. 5. Affidavit Spelling Errors
The Affidavit says: "visit Australia with my soon" (son) and misspells the father's name as "Rhman" (Rahman). Action: Re-type and notarize the Affidavit with correct spelling. Refusal Risk: Medium. Sloppy documentation suggests a lack of seriousness or a non-genuine application. 6. Son's College Documents
Tahmidur is a student (age 19), but only a testimonial is provided. There is no approval for leave. Action: Get a letter from Taibunnessa Khanam Govt. College stating the college is closed for Ramadan/Eid in March and he is allowed to travel. Refusal Risk: Medium. The Visa Officer needs proof he must return to Bangladesh to finish his studies (GTE requirement). 7. Duplicate Chamber Certificates
You attached two Membership Certificates: one expires June 2025 and one expires June 2026. Action: Submit only the certificate expiring in 2026. Delete the 2025 one. Refusal Risk: Low, but it confuses the application. Always submit only the valid, current document. 8. Valuation Report Date
The Asset Valuation calculates exchange rates as of 21.01.2026. Action: Recalculate assets using current/today's exchange rate and date. Refusal Risk: High. Relies on the "Future Dating" error mentioned in point #3. why u not find this i still find this '
